deleteDialogs.refreshComplete: The current list was refreshed. Select the item again to continue.
deleteDialogs.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the current list. Try again.

recording.title: Delete recording?
recording.deleted: The recording settings, versions, and internal delivery history will be permanently deleted.
recording.retained: The external database table and its written rows will be retained:
recording.acknowledge: I understand the recording settings will be permanently deleted.
recording.success: The recording settings were permanently deleted. The destination table and its rows were retained.
recording.history: Pending samples and delivery rows use different units. Accepted data keeps its original destination until delivered.
recording.active: Recording is still accepting data. Stop it before deleting.
recording.backlog: Pending data remains. Stop recording and wait for delivery before deleting.
recording.operationPending: A recording change is still in progress. Open the recording to review it.
recording.hasSuccessor: A later generation exists. Open the current recording to delete it.
recording.unknown: Could not confirm whether the recording was deleted. Refresh to check.
recording.refused: The server could not complete the deletion request. Refresh the current list before trying again.
recording.stale: The recording changed. Refresh its current details before deleting.
recording.stopUnavailable: Could not confirm that recording can be stopped. Refresh and try again.

device.stale: Refresh the device list before deleting.
device.title: Delete device?
device.description: Deleting a device cannot be undone.
device.referenced: Delete the following recordings before deleting this device.
device.blockedByRecording: The device was not deleted because a previously removed recording still needs attention. Review the recording before trying again.
device.typeName: Type the exact device name to confirm
device.unknown: Could not confirm whether the device was deleted. Refresh to check.
device.refused: The server could not complete the deletion request. Refresh the current list before trying again.
device.shareRefreshFailed: The device was deleted, but Modbus Share could not refresh. Refresh and review Share before continuing.
device.connectionCloseFailed: The device was deleted, but its connection could not be closed. Refresh and review the connection before continuing.
